title: Synthesis and biological evaluation of Sulforaphane derivatives with dual functions: Ischemia-reperfusion injury protection and antitumor effects.
authors: Peng, Yi; Shi, Xingyu; Wang, Qiong; Pan, Ying; Wang, Xinghao; Yan, Kang; Feng, Zikai; Zheng, Jinhong; Wang, Jinzhi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究莱菔硫烷衍生物对缺血再灌注损伤的保护及抗肿瘤作用，虽涉及Nrf2/Keap1通路和分子对接，但核心是药物化学与细胞实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Reperfusion therapy for the treatment of acute myocardial infarction (AMI) often leads to ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injuries, characterized by excessive ROS. Sulforaphane (SFN) homologous, known for their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, activate the nuclear factor-erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) pathway and reduce mitochondrial ROS but are limited by poor stability and short half-life. SFN derivatives were synthesized through structural modifications of the dithiocarbamate and thiourea moieties at the isothiocyanate group, aiming to enhance stability and maintain therapeutic efficacy. Compound 3g emerged as a promising candidate, demonstrating superior protection against hypoxia-reoxygenation (H/R) injury in cardiac microvascular endothelial cells (CMECs) and exhibiting good antitumor activity. Specifically, 3g reduced ROS levels by 24.5 % (compared to nifedipine at 17.8 %), increased NO production to 48.0 muM (vs. 44.0 muM), lowered TNF-alpha secretion to 22.6 pg/mL (vs. 23.9 pg/mL). Concurrently, 3g showed potent antiproliferative activity (IC(50) = 7.5 muM), with 3.8-fold greater potency than 5-fluorouracil (IC(50) = 28.2 muM). Stability studies showed enhanced resistance in both protic and aprotic solvents. Density functional theory (DFT) was applied to characterize the molecular properties of the optimal compounds. Molecular docking and ADMET analysis revealed that aromatic substitution and sulfur oxidation significantly improved Nrf2/Keap1 pathway targeting, highlighting the derivative's potential for stability and therapeutic efficacy. These findings suggest that 3g is a promising candidate for treating I/R-induced injury and oxidative stress-related cardiovascular conditions.
abstract_zh: 急性心肌梗死（AMI）的再灌注治疗常导致缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤，其特征为过量活性氧（ROS）。具有抗炎和抗氧化特性的萝卜硫素（SFN）同系物可激活核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）通路并减少线粒体ROS，但受限于稳定性差和半衰期短。通过对异硫氰酸酯基团上的二硫代氨基甲酸酯和硫脲部分进行结构修饰，合成了SFN衍生物，旨在增强稳定性并保持治疗效果。化合物3g成为有前景的候选物，在心脏微血管内皮细胞（CMECs）中对缺氧复氧（H/R）损伤表现出优越的保护作用，并展现出良好的抗肿瘤活性。具体而言，3g将ROS水平降低了24.5%（相比之下，硝苯地平为17.8%），将NO产生量增加至48.0 μM（相比之下为44.0 μM），并将TNF-α分泌降低至22.6 pg/mL（相比之下为23.9 pg/mL）。同时，3g显示出强效的抗增殖活性（IC(50) = 7.5 μM），其效力比5-氟尿嘧啶（IC(50) = 28.2 μM）高3.8倍。稳定性研究表明，在质子和非质子溶剂中均增强了抗性。采用密度泛函理论（DFT）表征最优化合物的分子性质。分子对接和ADMET分析显示，芳香取代和硫氧化显著改善了Nrf2/Keap1通路靶向性，突显了该衍生物在稳定性和治疗效果方面的潜力。这些发现表明，3g是治疗I/R诱导损伤及氧化应激相关心血管疾病的有前景候选物。
